requirement: Invitation group templates persist and generate reviewable drafts without overwriting approved emails

oracle.invariant: Five groups keep independent immutable template versions; a fresh route read returns persisted content and preview is read-only. Missing required templates reject generation atomically; preview and generated drafts use the same renderer. Default generation preserves customized and approved snapshots; explicit replacement clears approval and blocked or attempted recipients cannot be overwritten. Linked-identity suppression prevents generation, customization and approval across campaigns. Saving group two retains selection; generation opens Review emails filtered to that group. Failed saves and cancelled navigation preserve unsaved edits; confirmed reload of the selected campaign discards them consistently. Review lists drafts, Conversations lists messages, and Import describes recipient CSV rather than templates.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/db/index.js:52 readFile() with a computed path
